dialog-intro: Images made in design tools, by designers or as real-person UGC all work. Once their tags are confirmed they can enter experiments and be attributed by element, just like generated images.
review-intro: AI picked the closest value of each of this product's test factors for every image. Click to change a pick; “None of these” means the image doesn't show that factor.
product-none: No products yet. Set one up on the Products page first.
drop-title: Drop images here, or click to choose
drop-hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB each, at most 10 at a time
file-refused-type: {{name}} is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP
file-refused-count: At most 10 images per upload; the extra ones were not added
rights-label: I confirm we have the right to use these images in ads
note-placeholder: e.g. Made with Lovart, licensed until 2027
status-tagging_failed: AI couldn't tag it; choose by hand
ai-mock: Demo tags (controlled Mock, no model called)
no-vocabulary: This product has no test plan yet, so there are no factors to choose from. Confirm the image now and it can be a starting point for “Improve existing ads”; tag it after you set up an ad test.
confirmed-ready: Can enter experiments alongside generated images
confirmed-not-ready: No value chosen, so it can't enter experiments yet
confirmed-attributable: Delivery results will be attributed to round {{round}} by these values
problem-rights_confirmation_required: First tick “I confirm we have the right to use these images in ads”.
problem-upload_rejected: The image failed the upload check. Try another one.
problem-transfer_error: The upload was interrupted. Please try again.
problem-upload_unconfirmed: The upload result wasn't confirmed. Please try again.
problem-guardrail_exceeded: AI tagging would exceed the workspace's spend guardrail. Adjust the guardrail first.
problem-credential_unavailable: The workspace's OpenAI key is unavailable. Bind it again in Settings.
problem-external_creative_not_ready: This image is still being processed. Confirm it in a moment.
problem-unknown: That didn't work. Please try again.
